ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (approx. 85%) with low-intensity black margins and focal spots (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central high-intensity (white) region bounded by thick low-intensity (black) pigmentation along the trailing and lateral edges; a prominent low-intensity vertical column with irregular boundaries extends upward from the base toward the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; most pronounced jagged peaks are localized on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory extending from the median notch toward the lateral tips, ending in a sharp downward curvature at the outer boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-like high-contrast pixel clusters (5-10 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle scarring, located primarily near the notch and on the outer regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned linear pixel disruptions; a long diagonal scratch is visible on the left lobe and multiple shorter vertical and horizontal marks are scattered across the central white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both lobes; notable irregular indentation on the far left lateral edge; multiple dark linear rake marks on the inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique dark pigmentation pattern resembling a 'tower' or 'arrow' shape extending vertically from the center peduncle area toward the notch.
